Agents: [NOVA-1, Grid-Sector 7, aerial reconnaissance drone, operational — 40% battery remaining]; [BRAVO-3, Grid-Sector 9, ground rescue unit with medical kit and thermal scanner, operational]; [ECHO-5, Grid-Sector 6, communications relay vehicle with satellite uplink, operational]; [DELTA-2, Grid-Sector 8, heavy extraction vehicle with crane, low fuel — requesting resupply].

Objective: Locate and extract three missing civilians trapped in a collapsed industrial building at Grid-Sector 8 following a magnitude-5.8 earthquake. Extraction must be completed within 90 minutes before a secondary structural collapse is predicted.

Comms: [NOVA-1 → BRAVO-3: 'Thermal imaging shows two heat signatures on the northeast corner of the structure, second floor. Third signature is faint — possibly basement level. Battery at 40%, can sustain coverage for approximately 18 more minutes.'] [BRAVO-3 → ECHO-5: 'Relaying NOVA-1 data to incident command. We need DELTA-2 repositioned to northeast face before we breach. Confirm DELTA-2 fuel status.'] [ECHO-5 → BRAVO-3: 'Incident command acknowledges. DELTA-2 reports fuel for approximately 25 minutes of crane operation. Resupply truck is 35 minutes out — too late for full mission window.'] [DELTA-2 → BRAVO-3: 'I can reposition to northeast face now and begin crane stabilization. Recommend BRAVO-3 enters from ground-level east access while I hold the wall. Cannot confirm basement access without further scouting.'] [BRAVO-3 → NOVA-1: 'Can you do one low pass over the south face to check for basement-level access points before your battery forces return?']

Decision for NOVA-1: Whether to perform the requested low pass over the south face for basement access scouting, return immediately to base for recharging, or redirect remaining battery to maintain thermal surveillance of the two confirmed northeast signatures.

Constraints: NOVA-1 has limited battery — any additional pass reduces hover time over confirmed survivors; communication window with incident command runs through ECHO-5 only; DELTA-2's fuel constraint means extraction sequencing must be finalized within the next 10 minutes; BRAVO-3 cannot safely enter the structure without either crane stabilization or confirmed structural data.
